unassignedPolicy: Findings whose top-level puller cannot be traced to any owned dependency are reported with status 'unowned' for user triage. They are never silently dropped and never fixed by any task (spec §3).

targets.notes: Report-only monitor over the six root runtime dependencies. All six are also owned for remediation by their consuming packages (config-manager: lodash, yaml; logger: winston, winston-loki; form-field: preact, @preact/signals); this mirror is intentional. Owner uniqueness (no two tasks ever open PRs for the same dependency, spec §3) is enforced across all other targets; this monitor mirror is the sole exception because it never opens branches or PRs and never edits manifests (spec §12 root-monitor runbook).

zod is declared in root devDependencies but consumed by this package — ownership is by consumership (spec §3), so this task edits the root package.json/package-lock.json for it. lodash and yaml are declared in root dependencies and mirrored report-only in root-monitor.
winston and winston-loki are declared in root dependencies and consumed by this package; mirrored report-only in root-monitor.

preact and @preact/signals are declared in root dependencies and consumed by this package; mirrored report-only in root-monitor. reportOnly stays true until form-field's baseline debt is cleared (spec §6: 43 failing tests of 211, 10 lint errors). Re-check condition, every run: if the verify gate (scripts/dependency-hygiene/baseline.json / verify.mjs) shows the form-field debt cleared, flip this entry to reportOnly: false via a normal commit and follow the full package-worker runbook from then on.

express and @types/express are declared in root devDependencies but consumed by this package — ownership is by consumership (spec §3), so this task edits the root package.json/package-lock.json for them.
No external dependencies. Workspace-internal @tkottke90/* links are excluded from registry updates (spec §3); their updates happen through their own packages' PRs.
